いや、下手にこの話題を続けるのは危険だろう。
なにしろ一成は柳洞寺に住んでいるのだ。
俺が“見慣れない女”の事を訊いて不審がらせたら、一成は興味を持って何らかの行動を起こしてしまうかもしれない。

pages.en:
“——”

No. It would be dangerous to pursue the subject carelessly.

Issei lives at Ryuudou Temple, after all.

If my questions about an “unfamiliar woman” make him suspicious, he may take an interest and begin investigating on his own.

And if that woman is a Master, Issei himself would be in danger before anyone else.

“——”

That's enough for today.

I should be content with having established that Issei has nothing to do with the Holy Grail War.

「……え？ 桜、今日学校を休んでるのか？」

「……え？ 桜、今日学校を休んでるのか？」
pages.en:
“Oh, that reminds me, Emiya. Shinji's sister wasn't here today, was she?”

“…What? Sakura didn't come to school?”

pages.ja:
「慎二も休んでいただろう。二人とも無断欠席、家で何かあったのではないかと職員室で問題になっている」
「
」

pages.en:
“Shinji was absent as well. Neither of them gave notice. The faculty office is wondering whether something may have happened at home.”

“——”

Confronted with the problem I had forgotten, I find myself at a loss for words.

pages.ja:
「お、昼休みも終わりだな。教室に戻ろう」
一成に促されて生徒会室を後にする。
……その間。
学校を休んでいる桜と、ライダーを失った慎二の行方がぐるぐると頭の中で回っていた。

pages.en:
“Ah, lunch break is over. Let us return to class.”

At Issei's prompting, I leave the student council room.

…All the while, my thoughts circle endlessly around Sakura, absent from school, and Shinji, who has lost Rider.
